decisions.reason: Integrating videos with gallery pictures does not change the requirement to show representative imagery for each service on the Services page.
The decision concerns video placement and does not change gallery hover-animation behavior.
Displaying videos alongside pictures does not alter the source or target count of the portfolio photographs.
The gallery remains an interactive, scrollable gallery; integrating videos with pictures does not necessarily change its browsing behavior.
The gallery video-display decision is unrelated to the one-time pricing model and pricing tabs.
The decision does not alter individual-service selection, pricing transparency, or the pricing diagram.
Adding videos beside pictures is compatible with the existing highly visual presentation and does not replace or modify that requirement.
Placing videos beside homepage portfolio photos does not change the destinations or behavior of homepage page-link buttons.
The source does not change the requirement for homepage portfolio tiles to link to the gallery.
The gallery and homepage video-placement decision does not affect mobile pricing-table interaction.
Placing videos beside portfolio photos does not change the homepage hero image, overlay, or image-emphasis attributes.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that gallery videos are integrated with gallery pictures, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
